summary: CHRISTIAN AASBØ AS (org. no. 813 523 272) is a private limited company (AS) based in Gjerstad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2014-04-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.810 (Detaljhandel med motorvogner). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 14.5 m and net income was NOK 2.0 m. CEO: Christian Schaufel Aasbø; board chair: Christian Schaufel Aasbø; auditor: REVISJON SØR AS. Also: LEI 9845004969QB7D041D06.
